graph.title: Cursed Cobra Statue (LEGO Pharaoh's Quest 7325)

new_part_types.name: Brick 2x2 with two ball-socket ends (dark grey)
Plate 2x4 with wheel axle pegs (light grey)

parts.label: Small clip plate (tongue assembly, position assumed)

notes: The booklet builds two separate models: the jeep with its two minifigs (jeep steps 1-17, shown finished on page 14), and the obelisk with the cobra and the mummy (obelisk steps 1-17, then the cobra). The jeep is never attached to the statue, so the graph has two groups on purpose. The cobra does clip onto the obelisk fork in the last step, so those two are joined.

Piece identification from small images is partly inferred. Element ids come from the inventory pages (pages 48-49), and positions from the pictures. Joins between stacked pieces are approximate where the picture does not show which stud a piece sits on.

The inventory gives 12x plate 2x4 tan (4267874) for the 4 body segments, which is 3 per segment. The pictures show only two clearly (bottom and top). The third is modelled as a plate under the bottom plate, and its position is an assumption. The 13th plate is on the head.

Chain order for the cobra: head - segment1 - link1 - segment2 - link2 - segment3 - link3 - segment4 - tail block. Ball joints are modelled as ball/socket snap joints (the segment end bricks are typed with socket ports). Link 1's side hole takes a blue axle pin (b65) from the obelisk fork, per the last build step.

Inventory item 4569733 (a small dark grey clip plate) is not clearly located in any step. It is included as b130 attached to the tongue plate (b109), and that position is an assumption. 4515340 is used as the tongue hinge clip that connects to the head's hinge piece (4211814).

Element ids 73081 (windscreen stand, b14) and 9339 (woman's legs, b117) are kept exactly as printed on the booklet's parts page, so the piece counts match. They look short for LEGO element numbers and the print may be truncated. I could not find the full numbers, and replacing them with other ids made the parts disagree with the booklet's list, so they are left as printed. 9339 is a catalogue type.

The mummy pieces (4613494 and 4613454) are ambiguous in the images. 4613494 is treated as the torso (as in the catalogue) and 4613454 as the lower body, and the mummy's head and headdress are attached on top. The two snakes are held in the mummy's hands.

The woman and man minifig assignments of heads, hair and torsos (4613584 and 4637188 with reddish-brown hair 4614107, 4613411 and 4613488 with black hair 4526110) are inferred from the picture on page 3. The man sits on the car body and the woman on the rear plate.
Stickers (licence plate, door and obelisk prints) are not separate parts and are not modelled.

Part 4211029 is read as the pole plate that carries the scarab (steps 12 and 14). 4610761 is read as the scarab, and 4614107 as the woman's hair. Port kinds were set so the joins are valid pairs: the wheel-holder plate has axle pegs, the windscreen has a bar for the car clips, and the minifig head necks are anti-stud kind.
